## February 2023


### 20230216 Thursday

Attempt to start new diary system using markdown. Inspired by activities of the kids and desire to
recollect the progress. 

At Crown St, walk on the beach with James, Poppy, Wookie and Paddy.James loves the beach, pure joy, 
doesnt want to leave. Always gets wet.

Theo getting up on all fours. Moving backawards and eager to get crawling forward. Planks and pushups becomig common.

Daddy got nice cuddly with Theo in James bed for 10 minutes this morning. Very nice.

Moving to Cascade road later today.

Moved to cascade road. James on Tractor, chat with Lynn and Ray, BBQ dinner and a bit of scooting for James.

Drive up the hill in Camry with James holding the wheel.

### 20230219 Sunday

At  Cascade Rd staying in old house.

James loving tractor rides and waterslide and Fizzle and picking strawberries. 

James especially loves steering the wheel on the blue camry between houses. Theo also seems to love riding 
in the front seat.

Played with Daddy's Slot cars and Battle Dome.

Daddy got great cuddle with Theo on couch with, Daddy 95% asleep while Granny talking to Guy (17th) 

James regularly finishing my explanations or, his own, with a lovely "that's how the world works!".

Read books with Theo and James on me this morning - keeps the wriggler surprisingly still and interested.

Tour around McKenna's new house yesterday.

Pippa nearly pulled James over chasing paddy melons on walk down to new house this morning.

James and Pa had big excitement with Russels' pigs other day.

Trip to beach today with Nanny and Poppy. Daddy ran off for Indian buffet lunch with Guy and met
Jay the dentist.

### 20230222 Wednesday

Trip to Rhodo garden yesterday, very successful. James did lots of happy walking and talking in search 
of platypus. Found both Platypus and Echidna. Persistence rewarded as daddy went back down for second 
round with James to find platypus and got pretty good viewing from the bridge. 

Trip to Cradle yesterday with Nanny, Poppy, Granny and Pa. Great day despite James being a bit of a tired 
troll. James ate 3/4 of adult burger for lunch. I believe first bus ride for both kids. 

Theo woke with first tooth this morning. Mummy also had him standing against the couch for a short 
stint. 

On boat tonight. Bit sad to leave Tassie. Lots of tractor rides today and big hugs for Granny and Pa.

Fun new crab toy from Nanny and Poppy. 

Theo sitting on Poppy during ticket to ride talking and playing so happily, just gorgeous.

## March 2023

### 20230302 Thursday

Trip back on boat and drive home from Tassie quite successful, James very good on long drive thought
last few hours were very painful for Theo.

Sitting on deck working on lovely warm morning with Theo beside me in high chair shaking rattle and makeing
love noises. So nice to have him next to me while I work. Mummy and James peparing picnic for zoo trip.

In recent weeks James has regressed a little on toileting, inclung #2s in nappy after a 6 month period
where that only happened once. 

### 20230303 Friday

Changed a sleepy Theo at 4:30 this morning, clung to sleep as I did it, no fuss. AS I left to work
James said "I don't want you to leave Daddy". We had a nice hug and I told him we had an exciting weekend
ahead. Truly Lovely parenting experiences.

### 20230314 Friday


Trip to Bundeena over the weekend with Reece, Douglas and Sarah. Sarah 32 Weeks. James and Douglas 
played nicely for the most part, but James particularly good. 

Theo doing a goodjob sitting up and playing with toys.

Theo a little sick with fever, probably teeth coming through.

Theo very close to crawling, any day now I think. 

Went to sleep with Theo last night, just love it.

## April 2023

### 2023417 Monday

Been a while since last entry but so much cuteness. 

In recent weeks, Alysha visited, Yhi Feng visited for Easter, rode on Picnic Train with Reece, Douglas 
and Emil, Nanny and Poppy are now visiting.

Granny broke her hip on cruise ship in Japan (weekend Alysha was visiting), hip replacement in Japanese
hospital. 

Theo started crawling properly, scooting about, very determined to get to what he wants. 
Has begun attempting to stand, can get him self up on both feet in a Gamma shape - $\Gamma$ - when
he has something to hold on to. 

The has begun eating food and is very keen on it, flaps wildly when he doesn't have some immediately. 
Tried to steal James' bottle the other night while reading on James' bed. 

Theo had first orientation at Kinderhaven on Friday. 

James growing up. Nice Saturday morning, early up with James and Theo, building megablocks as a team, 
I told him how I've been looking forward to building with him as a proper team since he was Theo's age.

He is experimenting a lot with magnetiles, coming up with his own designs and imaginations. 

3 year old tantrums not fun, can easily get into a tiz. Trying hard with positive parenting. Yesterday
cam home from War Memorial with Mummy, Nanny and Poppy as absolute wreck. Punching, kicking, screaming. 
We sat on his bed and kept trying to talk nicely until he cooled down and agreed readign a book and 
playing a game would help. Quite lovely for the rest of the day, nice evening with Nanny and Poppy, 
very long bath, short little play of Planet Zoo. 

Occurred to me yesterday positive parenting requires focus on James, hard for Lori when she needs to 
be looking after Theo.

Started trying to play a little Planet Zoo, Smallworld and Ticket to Ride with James on the Computer.

Have applied for my new part-time arrangement, Thursdays off from 4 May, can't wait. Hopefully 4th is 
good weather for a trip to the zoo!. 

### 20230418 Tuesday

Lori had return-to-work meeting this morning so I took some time off and took Theo to the zoo, just
the two of us. Had a great time, Theo happy throughout, didnt get too much from the animals but enjoyed
the environment, the running water and the aquarium. 

Sitting having lunch and he's saying something very much like "Dad Dad Dad Dad".

Working on deck. Theo crawling about making lots of nice baby talking noises. So happy!


### 20230418 Wednesday

Last two nights 'reading' with James done a couple of pages of Where's Walley. Very nice! James doing 
much better at spotting characters, and doing well following instructions to narrow search area.

### 20230426 Wednesday

Beautiful morning yesterday (ANZAC day) playing with first with Theo from about 6:30 then later lovely morning
with James as well including bath with both at the same time (because Theo covered himself with Orange
and James wanted to be in the bath too).

Dinner with Josh and Rebekah last night. James very ratty around middle of day so took a nap and woke 
up just after dinner to have delightful play of magnetiles with Josh and Rebekah. Rebekah did Thomas
search and find with James before bed.

James has been doing great at searrh and find, including the lovely animal book Leonie gave him in Cairns.
Even spotting Walley before me on occassion.

Theo standing, crawling, walking with balance support like a champ. Fox on the Run by Sweet definite
winner for sleep. 


### 20230429 Saturday

Began swimming lessons this morning at Googong with both boys. James didn't want to go with daddy, insisted
on going with Mummy so Daddy got to take Theo which was good fun for us both. Mummy really just had
to watch James because he was in small class of 3 where parents are not required in the ppol.

Despite a rough start he started listening and did really well, and didnt want to leave when the half hour 
was up. 

This afternoon Mummy took James to print some photos at Kmart, Daddy and Theo got the loungeroom floor
back under control and at the end of all the fun Theo was ready for a nap, went to sleep on Daddy's
shoulder on the deck with nice solid rain for music and atmosphere (though he still wanted some
"If I had Words").

## May 2023

### 20230520 Saturday

So many nice things lately. Today was nice family day. James and Mummy went to the shop before swimming,
Daddy and Theo stayed home. 

Then swimming lessons, running a bit late but all enjoyed it. Theo starting to close his eyes for 1,2,3 
under. James seemed to have fun again. 

Called Nanny to sing happy birthday.

James had lovely day today for the most part. Went to the park with Mummy while Daddy, Theo and Pippa
went to bicentennial. Did two laps while Theo slept, Daddy listening to Audio books. Mummy and James 
came back and made dinosaur cookies. 

Theo so fun to feed, just loves his tucker.

Had lovely play on the floor with kids in the afternoon. Did a 1,2,3 blast off with Theo, then James
wanted a turn. Then Theo starts flapping because he wants another turn. Similar with Daddy rocker. So
exciting to see Theo asking for more as best he can. 

James tried to jump over the baby gate this evening and banged his head, big bump, but seems to be ok.

### 20230801 Tuesday

## Dercember 2023

### 20231203 Sunday 

Again too long between entires, gets to the point that there is too much to catch up on. Great weekend
despite challenges. James slept early afternoon through to 2330. Then he and Lori up all night.

Theo James and I up a bit before 7, Lori back to bed. After getting Thoe's nappy and dog breakfasts etc
sorted, went to maccers for a 'burger' as the excuse to go for a drive. James fell asleep in the drive 
thru around 815. James back into bed for a few hours. 

Theo and I took Pippa to walk at bicentnnial, around 8:40 now. Theo said 'hello' and 'bye-bye' to some 
strangers. Love his talking. He climbed the tower holdingmy hand, gave pippa nice cuddles, walked down
the stair holding my hand. Argument on the way back, he wants to walk byut ants everywhere and he puts 
rocks in his mouth so try to carry him as much as possible. Left bicep got a good work out today.

Back home, Lori and James still asleep, off to supermarket. Theo gets fed up of trolley so carried for 
large parts of it, left bicep stil working hard, but hes still a good shopping buddy. Give him the 
free banana just before checkout to keep him still while I unload the trolley. 

Out of supermarket around 1020 and Off to fyshwick markets for oyseters, prawns and scallops. Theo sleeping
koala by this point. Home aroudn 11. Theo into bed, wake James to get sleep pattern back on track. 

Few tasks then my first shot at making oysters for lunch, with prawns and little salad. Theo wakes up 
during lunch (naturally, instinctively will not miss a meal, love his food). Lor and James went off 
for a walk, Theo and daddy wnet to get ice then got washing in and away before storm. 

Another poop, second bath of the day for Theo and daddy, then long play in Theo's room while Lori worked
and James watched dino ranch. Beans for dinner, then Theo down. Wrote this while James finishes episode, 
now off to bed with James and hopefully asleep in good time to get up for Spurs vs Man City at 3am. 

Good day.
